<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

The PR adds a new `RAY_PLATFORMS` build variable constrained to `linux/amd64,linux/arm64` and updates the Ray mini image build targets to use it instead of the global `PLATFORMS` variable, ensuring the Ray container is built only for architectures with available PyPI wheels.

## Changes

**Ray mini image platform constraint**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Ray platform variable and target wiring** <br> `Makefile`|`RAY_PLATFORMS` defaults to `linux/amd64,linux/arm64`. The `ray-project-mini-image-build` target switches its buildx `--platform` from global `PLATFORMS` to `RAY_PLATFORMS`. The `kind-ray-project-mini-image-build` target sets `RAY_PLATFORMS=$(HOST_IMAGE_PLATFORM)` for local kind runs to use the host architecture.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12113](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12113): Both PRs touch the Ray mini image build flow; this PR constrains platforms via `RAY_PLATFORMS` while the other introduces e2e targets that call `ray-project-mini-image-build`.
